title: [spec-gap][R-CCP12-008/011/023] Rust/C channel selection not pinned to shared ccp16.json / ccp16-hop.json vectors
description: Sweep docs/spec-coverage/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md. Spec §3.2/§9: all implementations MUST produce identical output to test/vectors/ccp16.json. Rust: ccp16.json consumed only for SF/EMA/density (rust/lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs:1142-1146); NO rust test verifies channel selection against ccp16.json, and no rust consumer of ccp16-hop.json (CCP-12) exists — synchronized_hop_channel has property unit tests only (lib.rs:269-318). C: asn_sfn test re-implements the pseudocode inline + hardcodes one historic boundary (tests/asn_sfn/src/main.c:196-232) but consumes no ccp16-hop.json; lichen_link_channel_select untested (separate bead). Python is fully pinned (test_channel_plan.py:275-345, test_vectors.py:1814-1860, link/test_channel.py). Suggested: add rust tests consuming ccp16.json channel vectors (NChannels=3 plan) and ccp16-hop.json; add a C ccp16-hop.json consumer. Sequence after the rust-chain divergence bead resolves.
